module: Node "Random Number" (repeat_instant, casino icon). Generates a random number in [rangeStart, rangeEnd] every frame. Inputs: rangeStart (0), rangeEnd (10), float (hidden, false: integer). Output: random.
notes: In integer mode, math.random requires integers and rangeStart <= rangeEnd.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: If the bounds are defined, returns an integer (math.random(a, b)) or a float (a + random × (b-a)) depending on float; without bounds, returns math.random().
